scope: Source-anchored existing priors plus user-authorized editable assumptions for every current owned terminal race identity. Coverage includes body branches, shared normal-form profiles and transparent wrappers; equipment, target identity and abstract powers are not new owner bodies.

sources.title: Human — D&D Beyond
facts: Human height varies, with nominal reference points around five and six feet and taller individuals.

sources.title: Elf — D&D Beyond
facts: Humanoid Elves can be below five feet or above six feet.

sources.title: Dwarf — D&D Beyond
facts: Adult Dwarf height is described in the four-to-five-foot range.

sources.title: Gnome — D&D Beyond
facts: Gnomes are described as approximately three to four feet tall.

sources.title: Goblin — Archives of Nethys
facts: Goblin average height is given as three feet.

sources.title: Orc — D&D Beyond
facts: Orcs are described as approximately six to seven feet tall.

sources.title: Troll — d20 SRD
facts: A typical adult Troll is described as nine feet tall.

sources.title: Goliath — D&D Beyond
facts: The D&D Goliath species is approximately seven to eight feet tall.
sources.scope: Body-physique analogy for the existing Human + Goliath Archetype only. The video-derived Archetype is not a D&D species; no D&D racial trait or Giant ancestry is imported.

sources.title: Half-Elf — D&D Beyond
facts: Half-Elves have stature comparable to their Human and Elf parents, with nominal five-to-six-foot height references.
sources.scope: A selected reference for humanoid Human + Elf composition, not canon for every fantasy crossover.

sources.title: Ultraman Tiga — Tsuburaya
facts: The official Tiga profile lists a height of 53 meters.

sources.title: Ultraman Dyna — Tsuburaya
facts: The official Dyna profile lists a height of 55 meters.

sources.title: Ultraman Gaia — Tsuburaya
facts: The official Gaia profile lists a height of 50 meters.

sources.title: Ultraman Z — Tsuburaya
facts: The official Z profile lists a height of 52 meters.

sources.title: Meet Venom — Marvel HQ
facts: Official character introduction describes host-related strength and shapeshifting.
sources.verification: Verified official Marvel HQ search description; full video page unavailable to text browser.
sources.limitation: This source does not provide a numerical takeover-percentage versus height relationship. Search did not establish one; neutralization is a design decision, not proof that no such scene can exist.

sources.title: Pixie — licensed Roll20 D&D Compendium
facts: Pixie stature is described as roughly a foot or less.
sources.limitation: Element Pixie in this game is an adaptation; its 12–30cm interval and 24cm curve center are authored.

sources.title: RX-78-2 Gundam — Bandai official release
facts: The release describes the fictional RX-78-2 unit as 18m tall, separately from the 375mm scale model.
sources.limitation: 15–22m wheel bounds are game variation around this model reference; no toy dimensions or antenna scaling imported.

sources.title: Gipsy Danger — licensed Prime 1/Sideshow description
facts: The character description gives Jaeger height as 260ft; the collectible dimensions are separate.
sources.verification: Character-height paragraph verified in search extract; direct page fetch unavailable.
sources.limitation: 60–100m game support is authored; never use 68cm statue height as the fictional unit size.

conversion.centimeterRounding: Nearest whole cm for displayed lore interval endpoints; internal derived centers retain precision. Approximate lore ranges are not physical hard bounds.

policy.priority: Explicit user support ranges first, named form-specific reference next, chosen versioned species reference next; unknown forms require configuration.
policy.priors: Source mean/typical value when provided; otherwise explicitly estimated interval midpoint. A curated named-character sample is editorial, not a measured population.
policy.width: Broad-normal shape and widths are game-design policy, not empirical probabilities derived from wiki pages.
policy.crossovers: Equal mixture weights and conditional strengths remain explicit design assumptions; do not invent confidence percentages or self-train on generated spins.
policy.negativeEvidence: Failure to find a numeric rule does not prove impossibility; unsupported numeric interactions stay neutral until an explicit calibration is supplied.
policy.replay: Only future plans use new values. Frozen numeric support/odds/models and historical journals retain their saved versions.
policy.assumptions: User explicitly authorizes reasonable size assumptions for the remaining race/subrace profiles. Store support/center/body-form/metric and assumption label; no additional approval needed for these normal-form defaults.
policy.crossMetricComposition: Explicit per-profile principal-dimension projection at scale1 to characteristic-dimension, used only for mixed-metric composition. This compares declared body extents for the fantasy design, not physical equality of measurements. Missing/mismatched projection still requires an explicit body profile.
policy.manifestations: AI/Ghost/Elemental/Primordial abstract profiles measure rendered avatar/swarm envelope; no physical mass, damage, actual storm, planet or universe assigned from display size.
